definitions.gloss: changing room; locker room; dressing room
definitions.explanation: A room where people change clothes, found in gyms, pools, sports facilities, and stores.

examples.japanese: {更衣室|こういしつ}で{着替|きが}えてください。
examples.english: Please change in the changing room.

examples.japanese: プールの{更衣室|こういしつ}は{男女|だんじょ}{別々|べつべつ}だ。
examples.english: The pool changing rooms are separate for men and women.

examples.japanese: {更衣室|こういしつ}にロッカーがある。
examples.english: There are lockers in the changing room.

notes:
FORMATION:
{更衣|こうい} (changing clothes) + {室|しつ} (room)

LOCATIONS:
・ジム - gym
・プール - pool
・スポーツ{施設|しせつ} - sports facilities
・{試着室|しちゃくしつ} - fitting room (in stores, different term)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{更衣室|こういしつ}で{着替|きが}える - to change in the changing room
・{更衣室|こういしつ}を{使|つか}う - to use the changing room
・{更衣室|こういしつ}のロッカー - changing room lockers

SIMILAR TERMS:
・{試着室|しちゃくしつ} - fitting room (for trying on clothes in stores)
・{控室|ひかえしつ} - waiting room; green room
